title: Engine Oil and Filter Change
description: Drain old engine oil, replace oil filter, and refill with specified grade oil
instructions: Warm up engine to operating temperature
Drain oil completely using drain valve
Remove and replace oil filter using proper wrench
Install new drain plug with new gasket
Refill with 32 liters of 15W-40 engine oil
Check oil level and top up if necessary
Run engine and check for leaks
Update maintenance log
safetyRequirements: Wear safety glasses and gloves
Ensure engine is not too hot to avoid burns
Use proper lifting equipment for heavy oil containers
Dispose of used oil and filter properly
feedback: Task completed successfully. Oil was slightly darker than expected indicating good drainage timing. No leaks detected after completion.
completionNotes: All procedures followed correctly. Equipment ready for service.

title: Hydraulic System Inspection and Service
description: Check hydraulic fluid levels, inspect hoses and fittings, test system pressure
instructions: Check hydraulic fluid level in main tank
Inspect all hydraulic hoses for wear and damage
Check all fittings for tightness and leaks
Test hydraulic system pressure using gauge
Check operation of all hydraulic functions
Clean hydraulic tank breather filter
Top up hydraulic fluid if necessary
Document all findings
safetyRequirements: Depressurize hydraulic system before inspection
Wear safety glasses when working with hydraulic fluid
Use proper lockout/tagout procedures
Check for hot surfaces before touching components
feedback: Hydraulic fluid level was slightly low. Found minor leak at boom cylinder connection. Pressure test results within specifications.
completionNotes: Task in progress. Need to address minor leak before completion.

title: Track Chain and Sprocket Inspection
description: Inspect track chains for wear, check sprocket teeth condition, measure track tension
instructions: Clean track chains and sprockets of debris
Inspect track chain pins for wear
Check sprocket teeth for damage or excessive wear
Measure track tension according to specifications
Lubricate track drive mechanism
Check track alignment
Document measurements and findings
safetyRequirements: Ensure machine is on level ground and secured
Use proper lifting equipment for heavy components
Wear steel-toed boots when working around tracks
Be aware of pinch points

title: Transmission Diagnosis
description: Diagnose transmission failure and identify root cause
instructions: Connect diagnostic equipment to transmission control module
Retrieve error codes and review fault history
Perform visual inspection of transmission exterior
Check transmission fluid level and condition
Test electrical connections and sensors
Review operator report of failure symptoms
Document findings and recommend repair actions
safetyRequirements: Ensure vehicle is properly supported
Disconnect battery before electrical work
Wear appropriate PPE
Follow lockout/tagout procedures
feedback: Fault codes indicate solenoid valve failure in shift control circuit. Transmission fluid contaminated with metal particles. Root cause: Solenoid valve failure due to contaminated fluid.

qualityChecks.notes: Multiple codes related to shift solenoid circuit

completionNotes: Diagnosis complete. Recommend solenoid replacement and fluid system flush.

title: Transmission Solenoid Replacement
description: Remove faulty solenoid valve and install new unit
instructions: Drain transmission fluid completely
Remove transmission pan and filter
Disconnect electrical connections to solenoid
Remove bolts securing solenoid assembly
Install new solenoid with proper torque specifications
Replace transmission filter and pan gasket
Reconnect all electrical connections
Refill transmission with new fluid
Perform system test and calibration
safetyRequirements: Use proper lifting equipment for transmission components
Wear chemical-resistant gloves when handling fluids
Ensure proper ventilation in work area
Follow electrical safety procedures
feedback: Solenoid replacement completed successfully. Additional time required due to corroded bolts that needed special removal tools. New fluid installed and system tested.
completionNotes: Repair completed successfully. Unit tested and ready for service.

title: Blade Cutting Edge Replacement
description: Remove worn cutting edge and install new replacement
instructions: Position bulldozer on level ground and secure
Lower blade to ground and engage locks
Remove bolts securing worn cutting edge
Clean mounting surface thoroughly
Install new cutting edge with grade 8 bolts
Torque bolts to manufacturer specifications
Test blade operation and movement
Apply thread locker to all bolts
safetyRequirements: Use proper lifting equipment for heavy cutting edge
Ensure machine is properly supported
Wear safety glasses during grinding operations
Be aware of pinch points around blade
feedback: Old cutting edge removed successfully. New edge being installed. One bolt thread damaged and needs repair.
completionNotes: In progress. Addressing bolt thread issue.

title: Track Tension Adjustment
description: Adjust track tension to proper specifications
instructions: Measure current track sag using proper gauge
Locate track tension adjustment point
Add or remove grease from tension cylinder
Measure track sag again to verify adjustment
Ensure track alignment is correct
Test track operation by moving machine
Document final measurements
safetyRequirements: Keep hands clear of moving tracks
Ensure machine is on level, stable ground
Use proper measuring tools
Be aware of stored energy in tension system

title: Engine Service and Oil Change
description: Complete engine service including oil and filter change
instructions: Warm engine to operating temperature
Drain engine oil completely
Replace oil filter and drain plug gasket
Refill with specified oil grade and quantity
Check oil level and top up if needed
Run engine and check for leaks
Reset service indicators
Update maintenance records
safetyRequirements: Allow engine to cool to safe temperature
Wear protective gloves and eyewear
Dispose of used oil properly
Use spill containment measures

title: Hydraulic Leak Investigation
description: Locate and assess hydraulic system leak
instructions: Clean hydraulic system to locate leak source
Inspect all hydraulic hoses and connections
Check cylinder seals and rod condition
Test system pressure at various points
Use leak detection dye if necessary
Document leak location and severity
Estimate repair requirements and parts needed
safetyRequirements: Depressurize system before inspection
Wear safety glasses and gloves
Be aware of high-pressure injection hazards
Use proper lockout procedures

title: Drill Bit Inspection and Replacement
description: Inspect current drill bits and replace worn units
instructions: Remove drill string from hole safely
Inspect each drill bit for wear patterns
Measure bit diameter and cutting edge condition
Replace bits that exceed wear limits
Check bit rotation and cutting action
Install bits with proper torque specification
Test drill string operation
Document bit conditions and replacements
safetyRequirements: Follow proper drill string handling procedures
Wear cut-resistant gloves when handling bits
Ensure drilling rig is properly secured
Be aware of pinch points and rotating equipment
feedback: Replaced 3 out of 5 drill bits due to excessive wear. Two bits still within acceptable limits. New bits installed and tested successfully.

qualityChecks.notes: All worn bits identified and replaced

completionNotes: Bit replacement completed. Drilling efficiency should improve significantly.
